label: Every GOD_4 has the classical attributes, from the unique classical GOD_4 (inference)
rule: Any GOD_4 is the unique GOD_4, who has the classical attributes
meaning: UniqueClassicalGodExists gives one g that is GOD_4, is the only thing satisfying the signature's IsGod (IsTheOneGod), and has the skeleton's classical attributes. Let x be GOD_4; by IsTheOneGod, x is g, so x has the classical attributes. Constructive.
